hero.headline: Charlottesville is open for investment. Let’s tell that *story.*
hero.lead: Your economic development strategic plan calls for a clear economic development identity and a consistent “Why Charlottesville?” story that every partner can use. Hallpass can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.

photo.alt: People walking under the trees and café umbrellas of Charlottesville’s Downtown Mall on a sunny day

concepts.headline: Make Charlottesville’s advantages *tangible.*
concepts.lead: A connected editorial system—not one-off posts—could give investors, founders, talent, and visitors multiple ways into the same Charlottesville story.

plan.quote: Economic development and tourism are as much about *storytelling* as they are about policy work.
plan.quote_source: Charlottesville Economic Development Strategic Plan 2024–2028, Strategy 5.2
plan.outside_help_quote: One of the plan’s own findings: “Charlottesville’s economic development story is largely untold.” Goal 5 commits to positioning Charlottesville “as a community open for investment.”

pov.people_line: We start with people: the founder building in Charlottesville, the shop that’s anchored the Downtown Mall for decades, the UVA researcher whose work could change the world.
